issues.title: Add an is_palindrome(s) helper
issues.body: Add a function is_palindrome(s) returning True if the string is a palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters. Example: is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama") == True.

issues.title: Add a median(values) helper
issues.body: Add a function median(values) that returns the median of a list of numbers. For an even count, return the average of the two middle values. Example: median([1,2,3,4]) == 2.5.
